correctness.rationale: Solving the positive equilibrium equations gives Y=m(x), P=1/delta(x), K=kappa(x); the latter is positive with strictly negative derivative on I. The independently computed characteristic polynomial reproduces Q and its denominator. Exact endpoint signs and a positive interval derivative isolate one root in I; the exact rational endpoint images under decreasing kappa fit strictly inside the stated K bracket. At H=0 the factorization gives a negative real root and a simple imaginary pair. The derivative of the pair's real part with respect to K is about +0.055196937. A fresh outward-rounded enclosure with cross-product kernel vectors, explicit nonzero normalization, and interval elimination gave l1 about -0.545927284511569 (within the stated bounds). The spectral gap, positive crossing and negative coefficient yield locally orbitally attracting positive cycles above K*, with the stated local stability change. No global uniqueness or orbit at K=1.7 follows.
residual_risks: The independent calculation uses SymPy exact algebra and mpmath directed interval arithmetic; it is not a formal library audit or a finite-amplitude existence bound.
